days.note: Header read off the graphic: SET TIMES · MARCH 2023 · BAYFRONT PARK · FRIDAY 3.24 · FROM 4:00 PM TO 12:00 AM. Seven stage columns: ULTRA MAIN STAGE, LIVE STAGE, MEGASTRUCTURE and WORLDWIDE STAGE on the left panel, THE COVE, UMF RADIO and OASIS on the right; stage names are the column logos, uppercased (RESISTANCE prints over MEGASTRUCTURE and THE COVE). Every block prints a start only ("10:45 PM"), so every row is open-ended. A smaller coloured word beside or under a name (LIVE, HYBRID LIVE, THROWBACK SET, a presents line, the pair behind ENDLESS SUMMER) is kept in parentheses after it, as printed; a coloured B2B or B3B joins the names. This is the site's own 1600x1000 copy, which is legible. UMF RADIO prints the Revealed logo beside it this day; the stage is UMF RADIO.
